description: Acknowledge one inbox message after handling it. ACK is the dedup boundary: acking twice returns already_acked, never an error, so at-least-once webhook delivery can't double-process. Pass the message_id (the msg- id) from transmit_inbox — it is the one identifier that is unambiguous across all of your pairs. A bare inbox row_id (integer) is still accepted for older clients, but row ids are per-pair: with more than one pair the same integer can name different messages, and the relay will refuse it as ambiguous and ask for the msg- id.

message_id.description: the message_id (msg- id) from transmit_inbox; an inbox row_id integer is also accepted for older clients

name: transmit_ack
